hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: When k equals one, every integer in the range is a valid first power.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Find the maximal non-negative integer whose k-th power is bounded by r.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Subtract the maximal integer whose k-th power is strictly below l.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on base coordinates identifies power range boundaries in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating across all numbers in range takes O(r - l) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses integer binary search with overflow protection to compute integer roots.
